sections.body_md: ENTJ-A and ENTJ-T share the same ENTJ core. Within leadership, execution and systems decisions, the useful difference is how the two A/T styles handle confidence, pressure, feedback and self-correction, not which one is better.

content.quick_answer: ENTJ-A and ENTJ-T share the same ENTJ core. Within leadership, execution and systems decisions, the useful difference is how the two A/T styles handle confidence, pressure, feedback and self-correction, not which one is better.

faq.answer: Around leadership, execution and systems decisions, the main difference is usually confidence style, stress response, feedback processing and self-correction, not a change in the ENTJ core.
faq.question: What is the main ENTJ-A vs ENTJ-T difference?
faq.reason: Covers comparison intent and claim boundary.

faq.answer: No. A/T describes style differences, not a ranking. ENTJ situations can reward steadiness, caution or revision in different ways.
faq.question: Is ENTJ-A better than ENTJ-T?
faq.reason: Covers comparison intent and claim boundary.

faq.answer: Look at your response to leadership, execution and systems decisions-related pressure, criticism, uncertainty and post-decision review rather than treating the label as a verdict.
faq.question: How can I tell whether I am ENTJ-A or ENTJ-T?
faq.reason: Covers comparison intent and claim boundary.

faq.answer: No. It can support ENTJ work-style reflection, but it should not replace skills, experience, values or context.
